aboutSection.description: Design Vatika Architects is a multidisciplinary design firm offering premium architecture, interior design, and turnkey solutions across India. From sketch to final reveal, every corner reflects you, mixing practical, smart design with wow moments.
aboutSection.title: Let Us Design Your Space

children.text: Our celebrated luxury home project designed for India's top standup comedian, Mr. Harsh Gujral. Blending bespoke elegance, custom mood lighting, rich wood craftsmanship, and functional artistry.
Serene luxury wellness sanctuary with organic curved arches, warm terracotta tones, fluted glass partitions, and specialized task illumination.
Magnificent celebration banquet hall featuring column-free grand spans, theatrical parametric ceiling lights, soundproof operable acoustic partitions, and majestic foyer entrance.
Sculptural contemporary residential elevation showcasing geometric form, expansive full-height glazing, dynamic cantilevered canopies, and seamless transition between indoor and outdoor spaces.
Harmonious open-concept living and dining area featuring bespoke fluted wall paneling, Italian marble flooring, curated modern furnishings, and layered ambient lighting.
A peaceful sanctuary combining warm timber paneling, concealed atmospheric cove illumination, integrated walk-in wardrobe, and minimalist ensuite detailing.
Playful yet functional children's bedroom design featuring custom ergonomic study desks, vibrant geometric storage niches, and durable, tactile finishes.
Welcoming lounge space designed for hosting and relaxation, featuring plush sectional seating, accent marble consoles, and panoramic garden views.
Dynamic corporate workspace combining collaborative open workstations, sound-insulated meeting pods, biophilic plant installations, and energy-efficient lighting.
Commanding executive suite and conference facility highlighting acoustic wood slat walls, bespoke quartz conference table, integrated AV tech, and ergonomic leather seating.
Immersive experiential retail showroom with modular display islands, focused perimeter track lighting, and fluid customer journey zoning.

articles.title: Harsh Gujral Residence Completed in Greater Noida West
articles.summary: Design Vatika Architects delivers the bespoke turnkey residential retreat for renowned comedian Harsh Gujral, embodying warm minimalism, tailored acoustics, and curated luxury.

articles.title: Most Promising & Futuristic Architecture Firm of the Year 2024
articles.summary: Recognized nationally for architectural innovation, sustainable planning, and transformative residential and commercial landmarks across North India.

articles.title: 30 Under 30 Rising & Creative Architects Honor
articles.summary: Founding architects of Design Vatika Architects honored for visionary leadership and excellence in bespoke architectural design.

articles.title: Turnkey Design & Build Expansion Across 7 Strategic Regions
articles.summary: Executing full-scale architecture, interiors, and turnkey construction across Delhi NCR, Noida, Lucknow, Bareilly, Haldwani, and Ayodhya.
